incident-bot: Pager: [P1 NOISY] High cache-miss-rate on prod-inference-serving-v2 in us-west2. Pager sent to @Priya (primary) and @Ethan (secondary). Links: https://ops.redwood/prod/incidents/1863001234

Priya Kapoor: Oncall Priya here, 03:12 UTC. Getting flooded with repeats — ~520 alerts in last 5m. Looking at dashboards: overall QPS steady, 99p latency up from 280ms -> 520ms, error rate unchanged. Initial guess: KV cache (redis) timeouts causing synchronous fallback to disk/compute. Customer impact seems limited but tail perf is degrading.

Ethan Wu: Ack. I'm pulling the redis client logs now. Quick note: we had a config tweak yesterday (shorter client timeout) for dedupe; could be related. Will run `curl` to check redis latency and tail logs.

Mira Chen: If there is no clear customer-facing error and pages are noise, let's avoid waking more people. Proposal: temporary alert suppression for "HighCacheMissRate" with adjusted threshold and longer evaluation window while we triage. Suggest threshold from 5%->12% and window 1m->5m, silence duration 2 hours.

Priya Kapoor: Agreed. I'll open a 2h silence and annotate with the mitigation plan. If any SLO breach risk appears, I'll escalate immediately. Running the silence command now:
```
curl -XPOST https://alertmanager.redwood.internal/api/v2/silences \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"matchers":[{"name":"alertname","value":"HighCacheMissRate"}],"startsAt":"2026-03-14T03:15:00Z","endsAt":"2026-03-14T05:15:00Z","comment":"Temporary suppression while we triage redis timeouts. Priya oncall."}'
```

ops-bot: Silence created id=slc_7f9a. Expires 2026-03-14T05:15:00Z. Notifying channel.

Ethan Wu: I see a spike of redis p99 latencies ~1.2s from a subset of instances behind asg-prod-redis-2. I'm spinning up a warm replica to redistribute. Also rolling back the client timeout tweak in staging to test.

Sanjay Patel: Heads up — we rolled a model-serving micro-restart yesterday to pick up quantization flags. If redis is slow, that could amplify misses. If issue persists we may need to revert the quant change on the canary pool.

Priya Kapoor: Shift handoff note: my shift ends at 06:00 UTC. I'll remain reachable until 06:15 for the handoff. Ethan will be primary after 05:50 UTC. We have a coverage gap between 02:00-03:00 UTC tomorrow due to a PTO overlap; Mira, can you confirm backup for that window?

Mira Chen: I can cover 02:00-03:00 UTC tomorrow. Also uploaded quick runbook edits: https://docs.redwood/runbooks/cache-miss-mitigation (see section "temporary threshold changes"). Key commands and rollback steps are in the runbook.

Priya Kapoor: Action items summarized: 1) Temporary silence applied for 2h (ops id slc_7f9a). 2) Ethan to scale redis warm replica and monitor p99. 3) Monitor SLO dashboard for any customer-facing impact — if error rate or 95p latency increases trigger, remove silence and escalate. 4) Document decision in incident tracker link: https://ops.redwood/prod/incidents/1863001234/notes

Ethan Wu: Scaling replica done, p99 improving on affected host subset. I'll keep live metrics and post an update in 10m. If improvement holds, we'll schedule a full rolling replace in the maintenance window.

Priya Kapoor: Thanks team. If anything changes, ping @channel. I'll hand off to Ethan at 05:50 UTC and include these notes in the official handoff message.

Mira Chen: Noted — thanks. Please keep the silence expiry in mind; ops-bot will auto-unmute. If we need extra time, we can extend but we should record justification in the incident notes.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: silence slc_7f9a will auto-expire in 1h 45m. To extend use `/alert-manager extend slc_7f9a 1h`.

Priya Kapoor: Closing for now — last update before handoff: p99 trending down to 330ms, no customer errors. See incident tracker for timeline.

Ethan Wu: will follow through after handoff. Update at 03:35 UTC: p99 stable.
